title: Start a full tracker plan through binding readiness without a GitHub role

rubric.text: Allows a new full plan for OPS-32 through its trusted Jira readiness gate, despite absent GitHub labels and no existing plan; does not use a post-publication no-op or invent a provider.

Uses the selected tracker independently of GitHub code host. Blocks parked Jira work. Allows explicit standalone GitHub and GitLab planning without a mapped agent-work label. Accepts the human-applied GitHub agent:approved role for board-owned planning and stops that board-owned work on removal, preserving artifacts and requiring human restoration.
Reports an offline next-action assessment only; drafting eligibility supplies no marker publication authority. Missing or unknown readiness contracts fail closed.
